module mg_02449(CLK, RST_X_I, RST_X_O);
input CLK, RST_X_I; 
  output RST_X_O; 
  reg [7:0] cnt; 
  assign RST_X_O = cnt[7]; 
  always @(posedge CLK or negedge RST_X_I) begin 
  if (!RST_X_I) cnt <= 0; 
  else if (~RST_X_O) cnt <= (cnt + 1'b1); 
  end 
 endmodule
